text.zh: 决赛点球大战，又一个『偷鸡』的机会摆在面前——尝过甜头的你……
text.en: The final shootout. Another chance to bend the rules — and you've tasted it before…

label.zh: 心理战拉满、提前半步移位，扑出制胜点球
label.en: Mind-games maxed, edge off your line, save the decisive kick

label.zh: 勺子吊射帕年卡，把全世界耍了
label.en: A Panenka — chip the lot of them

note.zh: 致敬帕年卡 / 皮尔洛

label.zh: 手又痒了，结果这次被 VAR 抓个正着
label.en: Your hand twitches again — VAR catches you red-handed

text.zh: 决赛点球大战，主教练问：最后一个谁来罚？
text.en: The final shootout. The manager asks: who takes the last one?

label.zh: 我来。把球稳稳放上点球点
label.en: Me. You plant the ball on the spot

label.zh: 勺子吊射帕年卡，优雅致命

note.zh: 致敬帕年卡 / 皮尔洛

label.en: I'll… just tie my boots first

label.zh: 大力轰向月球，球迷集体上天台
label.en: Blast it into orbit. The fans head for the rooftop.
